Title: Test Architecture and Benchmark Suite
Content: MemorySmith.Tests uses NUnit 4 with Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.Testing for integration tests. All tests targeting file-backed services use isolated temp directories (Path.GetTempPath() + guid) created in SetUp and deleted in TearDown. ProjectWikiFixture.CopyToTemp copies Data/Memories into a temp location and returns the path; the fixture automatically finds the repo root via .slnx presence. TestServiceFactory.CreateMemoryApplicationService builds a MemoryApplicationService directly with an empty MemoryIndex (no pre-loading needed since SearchAsync uses store.LoadAll). RecordingEventStore and RecordingMemoryChangePublisher are in-memory stubs defined in MemoryApplicationServiceTests.cs. SearchBenchmarkTests (Category=Benchmark) exercises all three search modes with SearchProbe records defining query/expected-id/maxMs thresholds. Keyword probes use MustContainId (not TopId) because keyword search is a verbatim substring Contains — not ranked. Semantic and hybrid probes can use TopId for ordering assertions. ServiceFactory in SearchBenchmarkTests uses BackgroundServiceTelemetryTracker (concrete class, no interface). The MCP integration tests use WebApplicationFactory<Program> with in-memory config overriding DataPath/EventLogPath/Maintenance:Enabled=false. app.css append-only: use Add-Content PowerShell, never replace_string_in_file.
